# Second-wave tells

Load only when a Direction Lock `avoid` hit is ambiguous. The short list lives in SKILL.md. A pinned brief or `DESIGN.md` wins.

Banning indigo created the next average. These are defaults, not crimes: the same face or cluster is fine when the brief chose it.

## Font five and cousins

Space Grotesk, Instrument Serif, Geist, Syne, Fraunces as the page default. Same family when nobody chose them: Inter, Manrope, Plus Jakarta Sans. One headline word set in a second face, an italic, or a different color.

Source: Adrian Krebs design-slop-cop patterns 1–2; kill-ai-slop tells 07 and 33.

## Reflex clusters (Anthropic frontend-design)

Do not pick these because the axis was free:

1. Warm cream (~`#F4F1EA`) + high-contrast serif + terracotta
2. Near-black + a single acid-green or vermilion accent
3. Broadsheet: hairline rules, zero radius, dense newspaper columns

## Operate costumes (kill-ai-slop 34–35)

- **Tasteful terminal.** Mono on labels and chrome, near-black, one warm accent, ASCII as the product costume. Mono stays legal for code and data.
- **Editorial dashboard.** Serif greeting, cream paper, tracked-caps kickers, oldstyle figures in stat cells. A scanned UI wants a sans and tabular numerals.

## Also flagged on live pages (design-slop-cop)

Use as confirms, not as a browser scan during ship:

Glassmorphism on floating panels, saturated glow shadows, emoji in nav, centered Inter hero, perma-dark with grey body text, ornamental 1·2·3 steps, unmeasured stat banner, pill badge over the H1, FAQ accordion as a template closer.

Do not clone or run the URL scanner in the ship path. Its patterns are the list above.
